description: Read views can refresh from SSE; active edit snapshots never refresh underneath the user, including before the first edit. A stale revision blocks Save and preserves all draft properties/document text. The M3 live extension exercises the shared editor against HTTP/SSE as well as localStorage.

notes: Start provider-fs against a temporary content root, never live household content.
The live runner creates its own item and removes it afterwards.
External PATCH must GET the current {item,revision} first and include revision in the PATCH payload.
Use UI_URL and PROVIDER_URL to override the local service addresses.

actions.description: Runs actual agent-browser interactions, externally patches a revision-bearing HTTP item, checks draft retention and stale Save, then tests both outcomes of discard confirmation.

assertions.description: The live runner asserts the editor remains in Edit after incoming events and a conflicting Save.
The live runner checks a visible conflict, complete draft retention, and recovery downloads.
